response.original_title: {FAQ™Add Guest} How Do I Add Another Guest to My Crystal Cruise Room?
response.overview: To add a room on my Crystal Cruise, call Customer Service directly at +1 (866) 254-7549 US or +44 1204 208151 UK  or reach out to your travel advisor. Because each cabin requires its own booking, an agent will set up a new, +1 (866) 254-7549 US separate reservation. Make sure to ask them to officially link your booking numbers so your group shares the same main dining table and scheduled activities.  To add a room to your Crystal Cruise booking, contact +1 (866) 254-7549 US  or +44 1204 208151 UK  Crystal Cruise or your travel advisor as soon as possible. You can also check “Manage My Booking” on. Additional staterooms depend on availability +1 (866) 254-7549 US  or +44 1204 208151 UK and pricing, and linking reservations helps keep your group together for dining and activities. Fare differences may apply when adding cabins. Early requests improve chances of adjacent rooms.
